title: Surprise Visit Report: Quality Assurance
program: Skills for Industry Competitiveness and Innovation Program (SICIP)
subtitle: Unannounced visit to partner TI/TC

blocks.heading: Courses / batches scheduled today (routine or Training Delivery Plan)
blocks.note: One entry per running batch. Sections C, D and I pick these up automatically.

items.text: Centre open and training in session at the scheduled time

says.yes: The centre was open and training was in session at the scheduled time.
says.no: The centre was closed or no training was in session at the scheduled time.
says.partial: Training was only partly in session at the scheduled time.

items.text: Session being taught matches today's topic in the session plan / Training Delivery Plan

says.yes: The session being taught matched today's topic in the session plan / Training Delivery Plan.
says.no: The session being taught did not match today's topic in the session plan / Training Delivery Plan.
says.partial: The session being taught only partly matched today's topic in the session plan / Training Delivery Plan.

items.text: Training calendar displayed, provided to trainees and followed

says.yes: The training calendar was displayed, provided to trainees and followed.
says.no: The training calendar was not displayed, provided to trainees or followed.
says.partial: The training calendar was only partly displayed, provided to trainees and followed.

sections.title: Attendance and trainers in each course
sections.note: Count heads in the room first. The register and TMS are updated after the session, so take the average presence of the last 7 days from each.

blocks.note: One entry per course / batch from section A. Add courses there.

compare.message: Headcount is far below the 7-day average in the register / TMS

says.text: {course} {batch}: headcount {present_total} of {enrolled_total} enrolled[; 7-day average {register_avg7} in the register][ and {tms_avg7} in TMS][. {remarks}]

items.text: Attendance register up to date (no blank days)

says.yes: The attendance register is up to date with no blank days.
says.no: The attendance register is not up to date (blank days found).
says.partial: The attendance register is only partly up to date.

items.text: No attendance marked in advance for later sessions

says.yes: No attendance was marked in advance for later sessions.
says.no: Attendance was marked in advance for later sessions.
says.partial: Attendance was marked in advance for some later sessions.

items.text: Long-absent trainees entered in the dropout register

says.yes: Long-absent trainees are entered in the dropout register.
says.no: Long-absent trainees are not entered in the dropout register.
says.partial: Only some long-absent trainees are entered in the dropout register.

sections.title: Trainee identity spot-check
sections.note: Pick 5 names at random from the TMS enrolment list and verify each person.

options.label: Doesn't match

fields.label: Remarks
fields.placeholder: ID checked, entry qualification, reason for absence…
